explanation_en: White inserts a check before capturing the loose knight. Once the black king responds, the bishop takes the knight, gaining a tempo compared with an immediate capture.

intro.popup: 💡 中间招（又称「过渡」）：黑马a5无根是挂子。白方不急着吃，先插入Qf1+将军——王被迫应对，再回来吃马！
intro.popup_en: 💡 Intermezzo (also called a Zwischenzug): Black's knight on a5 is loose. Instead of capturing it immediately, White inserts Qf1+; after the king responds, White can take the knight.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Qf1+中间将军！黑王应将后，Bxa5吃掉挂马——比直接吃马多赚一步先手！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qf1+ is the intermezzo. After the king answers the check, Bxa5 wins the loose knight with an extra tempo.

moves.popup: 白后Qf1+！中间将军——不急着吃a5挂马，先强迫黑王应将！
moves.popup_en: White plays Qf1+ as an intermezzo. Rather than capture the loose knight on a5, White first forces the black king to respond.

moves.popup: 黑王Kg8——被迫应将，无法救马！
moves.popup_en: The king is forced to move to g8 and cannot save the knight.

moves.popup: 白象Bxa5！吃掉无根的挂马——中间招完成，多赚一子！
moves.popup_en: White's bishop captures the loose knight on a5. The intermezzo wins material.
